title: Add incremental changed-region compilation

scope.assurance_scope: PCSM Python v1 bounded, non-executing, CID-bound incremental changed-region compilation selection
scope.implementation_delta: Current-head ipfs_datasets already supplies the smallest authority-complete delta: RepositoryScanner@1 re-analyzes only changed source-CID regions after verified prior-state admission while always recomputing live graph resolution, and SemanticCapsuleCompiler@1 reuses only CID- and byte-reverified unchanged capsule blocks. This receipt selects and binds those authorities; it does not add a proof_context wrapper, competing compiler/CID/source-map authority, or an M2/M3 mutation path.

selected_existing_authority.changed_region_api: RepositoryScanner.scan(repository, previous_state=None, snapshot=None) and scan_snapshot(snapshot, sources, previous_state=None)
algorithm_and_fail_closed_invariants: A prior RepositoryState is admitted only when repository identity, schema, extractor name, and extractor version match; otherwise all current source regions are re-analyzed and a typed reject reason is retained in ephemeral diagnostics.
For an admitted prior state, only paths with matching current snapshot source CIDs reuse previous verified SymbolRecords. Changed source-CID paths are re-analyzed from current captured bytes.

Pytest unification, dependency-lock wiring, and symbol-graph resolution always recompute from the current inventory, so reuse cannot preserve stale dependent edges. Reuse diagnostics never enter the durable repository-state root.
The changed-region result is fully recomputed to a current RepositoryState CID; a cold scan over the same bytes must equal the incremental state and state CID.

Capsule compilation first rederives every current capsule/index block and then reuses prior bytes only when the computed CID is equal and the bytes are canonical and byte-identical. Divergent or malformed prior blocks are not trusted.

The scanner parses source and never imports or executes examined modules. This is bounded static Python v1 analysis, not runtime equivalence, a source rewriter, a formal proof system, or a PCSM SourceLinkReceipt authority.
selected_existing_authority.minimum_delta_reason: The current-head authorities are already versioned, schema-closed, CID-bound, deterministic where required, and covered by direct positive and negative tests. Reimplementation would duplicate canonical semantic-analysis authority and violates the receipt-only declared output boundary.

limitations: This task is receipt-only: it selects existing current-head incremental authority and does not mutate proof_context or create a second compiler.

The selected authority is bounded static Python AST analysis and content-addressed capsule materialization. It does not establish whole-CPython runtime semantics, runtime dynamic-import outcomes, reflection/native behavior, or generated-code correctness.

A changed source region is determined from a sealed snapshot source CID, not an editor diff. Unchanged source records may be reused only after prior-state admission; dependent graph resolution and current root construction still rerun.
All identities are valid only under the bound source digests, schemas, extractor/CID profile, and snapshot coordinates; any change invalidates this receipt.
The authoritative sealed suite remains unavailable because anyio is absent, so this receipt cannot promote completion.
The receipt's own canonical storage CID is unavailable because minting a self-describing CID would change its bytes.
